counterexamples.evidence: Render-side leak of internal vocabulary into a line the model reads; runs 0 and 2 echoed it as "negar ese recurso en la pelea de paridad" and "tu recurso de profundidad decide la partida" — meaningless to a player. The reading key bans "window"/"completing cell"/"histogram" but not "resource", and the board headings themselves are never sanitised.
Prompt renders the sides as "Y = you (player 1), O = opponent (player 2)" and never uses a colour word; runs 0 and 2 still wrote "gris" / "verde", the 3rd-person player naming A5a forbids.

Run 0 writes "mantenías la línea de cuatro en la parte alta y ADEMAS dejabas para más adelante [zone:future:windows:...]la línea de cuatro..." — the first "línea de cuatro" is unwrapped and uncelled, and "además" frames it as a different line that exists on no board.
